page.overview:
Who is Bow?

Clone Lieutenant Bow, designated CC-2201, was a clone trooper officer of the 501st Legion who served during the Clone Wars. Following the Proclamation of the New Order that transitioned the Galactic Republic into the Galactic Empire, Bow served as the second-in-command of Shadow Platoon under his old commander, Clone Commander Appo and Lord Vader.

CC-2201 was the designation of a clone during the final stages of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Bow served in the 501st Legion and was part of created when Jedi General Anakin Skywalker divided the unit in two; one unit, of which Bow was part, journeyed to the Republic capital planet Coruscant to reinforce the besieged world under Skywalker and Clone Commander Appo's command whereas the other half—the 332nd Division—traveled to the planet Mandalore under the command of Clone Commander Rex so as to assist Skywalker's former Padawan Ahsoka Tano in capturing the rogue Sith Lord Maul.

Following the engagement, Appo's troopers remained stationed on Coruscant as Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, secretly the Dark Lord of the Sith known as Darth Sidious, activated Order 66 to all forces and branded the Jedi Order as traitors. of clone troopers who took part in the operation.

The 501st sacked the Temple, killing all of its inhabitants. and fires ignited into a large blaze. Witnessing the unfolding situation, Republic Senator Bail Prestor Organa travelled to the Jedi Temple in his airspeeder and set down on a landing pad. A unit of clones confronted the senator. Bow and his superior officer, Commander Appo, were also present as part of Fox's clone contingent, with Appo ordering the senator to leave. As Organa left, Jedi Padawan Zett Jukassa ambushed the group of clones, seriously injuring Appo and taking down six other clones before coming under fire. Bow fired the fatal shot, and Sergeant Fox ordered his troops to let Organa flee.
